<script>
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  $(function() {
    try {
      if (!Cookies.get('pages')) {
        Cookies.set('pages', [{url: window.location.href, time: new Date().getTime()}], {expires: 365 * 100});
      } else {
        console.log(Boolean(Cookies.get('pages')));
        console.log(Cookies.get('pages'));
        const newPages = JSON.parse(Cookies.get('pages'));
        console.log(newPages);
        console.log(typeof newPages);
        newPages.push({url: window.location.href, time: new Date().getTime()});
        Cookies.set('pages', newPages, {expires: 365 * 100});
      }
    } catch(err) {
      console.log(err);
    }

    if (!Cookies.get('firstPage')) {
      console.log('setting');
      Cookies.set('firstPage', window.location.href, {expires: 365 * 100});
      Cookies.set('referer', document.referrer, {expires: 365 * 100});
    }
    if (!Cookies.get('fp')) {
      let referralCookie;
      if (window.location.href.indexOf('fp_ref=') !== -1) {
        referralCookie = window.location.href.split('fp_ref=')[1].split('&')[0];
      }
      if (window.location.href.indexOf('fpr=') !== -1) {
        referralCookie = window.location.href.split('fpr=')[1].split('&')[0];
      }
      if (window.location.href.indexOf('via=') !== -1) {
        referralCookie = window.location.href.split('via=')[1].split('&')[0];
      }
      if (referralCookie) {
      Cookies.set('fp', referralCookie ,
      {expires: 365 * 100});
      }
    }
  });
});
</script>
<script>
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  $(function() {
    $('.google').click(function(){
      OAuth.redirect('google', '/google-sign-in');
    });
    $('.github').click(function(){
      OAuth.redirect('github', '/github-sign-in');
    });
  });
});

<script>
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  $(function() {
    if (window.location.href.indexOf('google-sign-in') !== -1) {
      OAuth.callback('google')
      .done(function(result) {
          result.me().done(function(data) {
            const firstPage = Cookies.get('firstPage');
            const referer = Cookies.get('referer');
            const fp = Cookies.get('fp');
            let backupApiUrl = window.location.href.indexOf('scraperapi') !== -1 ?
              'https://server.scraperapi.com': 'http://localhost:5000';
            axios.defaults.withCredentials = true;
            axios.post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/sign-in', {name: '', email:
              data.email, type: 'google', firstPage, referer, fp})
            .then(function() {
              window.location = '/dashboard';
            })
            .catch(function(err){
              alert(JSON.stringify(err));
              window.location = '/dashboard';
            });
          })
        //use result.access_token in your API request
        //or use result.get|post|put|del|patch|me methods (see below)
      })
      .fail(function (err) {
        //handle error with err
        window.location = '/';
      });
    }
    if (window.location.href.indexOf('github-sign-in') !== -1) {
      OAuth.callback('github')
      .done(function(result) {
          result.me().done(function(data) {
            const firstPage = Cookies.get('firstPage');
            const referer = Cookies.get('referer');
            const fp = Cookies.get('fp');
            let backupApiUrl = window.location.href.indexOf('scraperapi') !== -1 ?
              'https://server.scraperapi.com': 'http://localhost:5000';
            axios.defaults.withCredentials = true;
            axios.post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/sign-in', {name: data.name, email:
              data.email, type: 'github', firstPage, referer, fp})
            .then(function() {
              window.location = '/dashboard';
            })
            .catch(function(err){
              alert(JSON.stringify(err));
              window.location = '/dashboard';
            });
          })
        //use result.access_token in your API request
        //or use result.get|post|put|del|patch|me methods (see below)
      })
      .fail(function (err) {
        //handle error with err
        window.location = '/';
      });
    }
    let requesting = false;
    $('#email-signup').click(function() {
      const email = $('#email').val();
      const password = $('#password').val();
      if (!email || email.indexOf('@') === -1) {
        $('#error-message').html('Please enter a valid email');
      } else if (!password) {
        $('#error-message').html(`Please enter a password or reset your password.`);
      } else {
        if (!requesting) {
          requesting = true;
          $('#error-message').html('Creating account...');
          let backupApiUrl = window.location.href.indexOf('scraperapi') !== -1 ?
            'https://server.scraperapi.com': 'http://localhost:5000';
          axios.defaults.withCredentials = true;
          axios
            .post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/sign-in', {email, password,
            firstPage: Cookies.get('firstPage'), referer:
            Cookies.get('referer'), type: 'emailSignup'})
            .then(function(){
              requesting = false;
              $('#error-message').html(`A verification link has been
              sent to ${email}!`);
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
              requesting = false;
              $('#error-message').html(err.response.data);
            });
        }
      }
    });
    $('#request-reset').click(function() {
      const email = $('#email').val();
      if (!email || email.indexOf('@') === -1) {
        $('#error-message').html('Please enter a valid email');
      } else {
        if (!requesting) {
          requesting = true;
          $('#error-message').html('Resetting password...');
          let backupApiUrl = window.location.href.indexOf('scraperapi') !== -1 ?
            'https://server.scraperapi.com': 'http://localhost:5000';
          axios.defaults.withCredentials = true;
          axios
            .post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/request-reset', {email})
            .then(function(){
              requesting = false;
              $('#error-message').html(`A password reset link has been sent to your inbox!`);
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
              requesting = false;
              $('#error-message').html(err.response.data);
            });
        }
      }
    });
    $('#reset-password').click(function() {
      const password = $('#password').val();
      if (!password) {
        $('#error-message').html('Please enter a password');
      } else {
        if (!requesting) {
          requesting = true;
          $('#error-message').html('Resetting password...');
          let backupApiUrl = window.location.href.indexOf('scraperapi') !== -1 ?
            'https://server.scraperapi.com': 'http://localhost:5000';
          axios.defaults.withCredentials = true;
          axios
            .post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/reset', {password})
            .then(function(){
              requesting = false;
              window.location = '/dashboard';
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
              requesting = false;
              $('#error-message').html(err.response.data);
            });
        }
      }
    });
    $('#email-login').click(function() {
      const email = $('#email').val();
      const password = $('#password').val();
      if (!email || email.indexOf('@') === -1) {
        $('#error-message').html('Please enter a valid email');
      } else if (!password) {
        $('#error-message').html(`Please enter a password or reset your password.`);
      } else {
        if (!requesting) {
          requesting = true;
          $('#error-message').html('Signing in...');
          let backupApiUrl = window.location.href.indexOf('scraperapi') !== -1 ?
            'https://server.scraperapi.com': 'http://localhost:5000';
          axios.defaults.withCredentials = true;
          axios
            .post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/sign-in', {email, password,
            firstPage: Cookies.get('firstPage'), referer:
            Cookies.get('referer'), type: 'emailLogin'})
            .then(function(){
              requesting = false;
              window.location = '/dashboard';
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
              requesting = false;
              $('#error-message').html(err.response.data);
            });
        }
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>
<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    $(function() {
      let requesting = false;
      $('#footer-email-signup').click(function() {
        const email = $('#footer-email').val();
        const password = $('#footer-password').val();
        if (!email || email.indexOf('@') === -1) {
          $('#footer-error-message').html('Please enter a valid email');
        } else if (!password) {
          $('#footer-error-message').html('Please enter a password');
        } else {
          if (!requesting) {
            requesting = true;
            $FPROM.trackSignup({
            email:email}, function(){console.log('Callback received!')});
            $('#footer-error-message').html('Creating account...');
            const firstPage = Cookies.get('firstPage');
            const referer = Cookies.get('referer');
            let backupApiUrl = window.location.href.indexOf('scraperapi') !== -1 ?
              'https://server.scraperapi.com': 'http://localhost:5000';
            axios.defaults.withCredentials = true;
            axios
              .post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/sign-in', {email, password,
              firstPage, referer, type: 'emailSignup'})
              .then(function(){
                requesting = false;
                $('#footer-error-message').html(`A verification link has been
                sent to ${email}!`);
              })
              .catch(function(err) {
                requesting = false;
                $('#footer-error-message').html(err.response.data);
              });
          }
        }
      });
    });
  });
</script>

<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    $(function() {
      let backupApiUrl = window.location.href.indexOf('scraperapi') !== -1 ?
        'https://server.scraperapi.com': 'http://localhost:5000';
      axios.defaults.withCredentials = true;
      console.log('executing');
      axios.get((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users')
        .then(function(user) {
          console.log(user);
          if (!user.data) {
            $('#navbar-user').html(
              '<a class="nav-link text-muted" href="/login"><small>Login</small></a>'
            );
            $('#navbar-user-mobile').html(
              '<a class="nav-link text-muted" href="/login"><small>Login</small></a>'
            );
          } else if (window.location.href.indexOf('dashboard') == -1 &&
          window.location.href.indexOf('billing') == -1) {
            $('#navbar-user').html(
              '<a class="nav-link text-muted" href="/dashboard"><small>Go to Dashboard</small></a>'
            );
            $('#navbar-user-mobile').html(
              '<a class="nav-link text-muted" href="/dashboard"><small>Go to Dashboard</small></a>'
            );
            console.log('here');
            const pages = Cookies.get('pages');
            console.log('sending pages');
            axios.post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/pages', {pages})
              .then(function() {
                Cookies.remove('pages');
              })
              .catch(function(err) {
                console.log(err);
              });
          } else {
            $('#navbar-user').html('<small class="text-muted logout" style="cursor:pointer;">Logout</small>');
            $('#navbar-user-mobile').html('<small class="logout" style="cursor:pointer;">Logout</small>');
            console.log('here');
            const pages = Cookies.get('pages');
            console.log('sending pages');
            axios.post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/pages', {pages})
              .then(function() {
                Cookies.remove('pages');
              })
              .catch(function(err) {
                console.log(err);
              });
          }
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
          console.log(err);
        });
        $(document).on('click', '.logout', function() {
          axios
            .post((apiUrl || backupApiUrl) + '/users/logout')
            .then(function() {
              window.location = '/';
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
              console.log(err);
            });
        });
    });
  });
</script>

<div class="col-lg-5 text-center p-4 d-flex align-items-center">
<div>
<h3>Never Get Blocked</h3>
<p style="font-size: 20px;">
        One of the most frustrating parts of automated web scraping is constantly dealing
        with IP blocks and CAPTCHAs. Scraper API rotates IP addresses with each
        request, from a pool of millions of proxies across over a dozen ISPs, and
        automatically retries failed requests, so you will
        never be blocked. Scraper API also handles CAPTCHAs for you, so
        you can concentrate on turning websites into actionable data.
        </p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="offset-lg-1 col-lg-5 text-center p-4 d-flex align-items-center">
<div>
<h3>Fully Customizable</h3>
<p style="font-size: 20px;">
        Scraper API is not only easy to start with, it's also easy to
        customize. Scraper API allows you to customize request headers, request
        type, IP geolocation and more. Easily render javascript with a headless
        browser simply by setting render=true. Create sessions to reuse IP
        addresses multiple times. See our <a href="/documentation">documentation</a> for more details.
        </p>
</div>
